name: Phenol
aliases: C6H5OH, PhOH, IPH, carbolic acid, IZAL, benzenol, benzophenol, carbolic oil
summary: Phenol (also known as carbolic acid, phenolic acid, or benzenol) is an aromatic organic compound with the molecular formula C6H5OH. It is a white crystalline solid that is volatile and can catch fire.

uses.text: It is primarily used to synthesize plastics and related materials.
